summary: Trilogy Metals Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to a binding letter of intent with South32 Limited, Ambler Metals LLC, and the U.S. Department of War (DOW). The amendment extends the closing deadline for a previously announced US$35.6 million strategic equity investment by the DOW from May 31, 2026, to July 31, 2026, to finalize definitive documentation. Other terms remain unchanged. The extension is procedural, not a fundamental change in deal structure, so this is not a new special situation. Watch for completion by the new deadline or further delays.
